## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |

## Settings

| Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| signal_col | `signal_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Numeric signal column. |
| time_col | `time_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Date or numeric column continued over the future rows. |
| method | `method` | Choice | `holt_winters` | `simple`, `holt`, `holt_winters` | The run | Method. |
| seasonal | `seasonal` | Choice | `additive` | `additive`, `multiplicative` | The run | Holt-Winters season. |
| period | `period` | Integer | `-1` |   | The run | Holt-Winters period (-1 finds it) |
| damped | `damped` | On / off | `false` |   | The run | Damped trend (Holt) |
| alpha | `alpha` | Number | `-1` |   | The run | Level weight (-1 estimates it) |
| beta | `beta` | Number | `-1` |   | The run | Trend weight (-1 estimates it) |
| gamma | `gamma` | Number | `-1` |   | The run | Season weight (-1 estimates it) |
| horizon | `horizon` | Integer | `12` |   | The run | Future rows (0: the in-sample fit only) |
| level | `level` | Number | `0.95` |   | The run | Prediction interval level. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).
